content.about: São Tomé and Príncipe is a small island country in the Gulf of Guinea, off Central Africa. Its two main islands are volcanic and covered in rainforest. It was once a top cocoa producer. Many plants and birds there are found nowhere else.

standout.text: Pico Cão Grande is a dramatic volcanic spire rising about 300 m above the jungle.

didYouKnow: The equator passes through an islet just south of São Tomé.
It is Africa's second-smallest country by population.
Its cocoa is prized by chocolate makers.
